title: The father who came instead of his son
situation: A smiling father from Kolkata comes to Jantar Mantar on behalf of his son stuck in London, joking he would take a police beating in his place, and asks the reporter where to go.

lines.text: Willing to take a police beating in his son's place.
lines.speaker: father

buildThis.situation: An uncle wanders in "on behalf of my son in Canada" and asks the player where to stand; he becomes the person the player has to keep safe at 16:00.
